entries.not_relevant_because: Neither manuscript mentions NP, certificates, or the P versus NP question. Both concern whether choiceless polynomial time with counting (a logic over hereditarily finite sets) defines every polynomial-time query on unordered finite structures. The separating query is itself shown to be decidable in deterministic polynomial time, so the result separates P from a logic, not P from NP. The only link is that both are about descriptive-complexity capture, which the matching pass noted as adjacent.
